# docker_buildx_disk_usage (Data Source)

Reads the build cache of a buildx builder, like `docker buildx du --verbose`: one entry per cache record with size, type, sharing and usage, plus the shared, private, reclaimable and total sizes printed under the table. For the daemon-wide view of images, containers and volumes use `docker_system_df`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_buildx_disk_usage" "cache" {
  builder = "default"
  filters = {
    type = "regular"
  }
}

output "build_cache_bytes" {
  value = data.docker_buildx_disk_usage.cache.summary
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `builder` (String) Builder whose cache is read (`--builder`). Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit (reached over the daemon's `/grpc` endpoint); other names are docker-container builders on the provider's daemon.
- `filters` (Map of String) Map of BuildKit cache filter keys to values (`--filter`), e.g. `{ type = "regular" }` or `{ description = "~pulled" }` (a leading `~` matches by substring). Keys: `id`, `parents`, `description`, `type`, `inuse`, `mutable`, `shared`, `private`.

### Read-Only

- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of disk_usage_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `disk_usage_json` (String) Build cache records of the builder plus the totals, as one JSON document.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply.
- `ids` (List of String) Cache record ids, largest first, e.g. for a targeted `docker_builder_prune` filter.
- `records` (Attributes List) One entry per build cache record (all 11 `buildx du --format` placeholders). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `summary` (Attributes) Totals in bytes as printed under the table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Upstream `CreatedAt`.
- `description` (String) Upstream `Description`.
- `id` (String) Upstream `ID`.
- `last_used_at` (String) Upstream `LastUsedAt`.
- `mutable` (Boolean) Upstream `Mutable`.
- `parents` (List of String) Upstream `Parents`.
- `reclaimable` (Boolean) Upstream `Reclaimable`.
- `shared` (Boolean) Upstream `Shared`.
- `size` (Number) Upstream `Size`.
- `type` (String) Upstream `Type`.
- `usage_count` (Number) Upstream `UsageCount`.


<a id="nestedatt--summary"></a>

Read-Only:
